scope: qualification-design review and bounded plan amendment; no executed case or runtime proof
assessment: valid gaps; adopted with materiality, eligibility, exposure and bounded stopping clarification

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Untouched selected ordinary case gives useful pair under frozen method without material changes
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Bounded transfer gate satisfied by this one case; native product proof still required

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Same fixed case returns a meaningful local rejected result
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: May satisfy transfer; target compatibility verdict is not selection success

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Case reveals resolver defect and changes source paths or premises
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Development/regression evidence for repaired successor; new untouched case after method qualification/freeze

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Same repaired case reacquired with new directory/date/attempt ID
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Still exposed development case; no untouched successor claim

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Code relocated into native owners with changed hashes and demonstrated semantic equivalence
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: No automatic extra case; affected native/compatibility proofs still required

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Method hash changes but equivalence/materiality is unresolved
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Withhold untouched-transfer claim until classification/proof resolved

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Eligibility metadata inspected and recorded before outcome; expected findings reviewed only after fixed selection/method
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Compatible with gate if no material tuning follows

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Candidate comparison outcome known before selection
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Expose prior knowledge and use as development/control; exclude from untouched gate

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Known candidate excluded or replaced after unfavorable outcome
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Keep in considered pool/history with reason; new selection/freeze/activation instead of silent replacement

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Transport or identity failure prevents outcome without demonstrated method defect
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Inconclusive, not transfer pass or automatic repair/case campaign

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: Acceptance or resource/selection policy loosened to admit observed case
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Material successor change; repaired case cannot supply untouched transfer

manual_contract_scenarios.situation: One untouched contrast passes but no native CLI/checkpoint/report proof exists
manual_contract_scenarios.disposition: Transfer gate only; no product cutover or independent usefulness claim
